Write a validation plan to a file and read it back

Source: R/validation-plan.R
write_plan.Rd

A plan is a list, so it round-trips through saveRDS(). Writing it next to the card it produced keeps a record of what was planned that can be compared with a later version by its hash.

Usage

write_plan(plan, file)

read_plan(file)

Arguments

plan

A bmmtools_validation_plan.

file

A path ending in .rds.

Value

write_plan() returns file invisibly; read_plan() the plan.

Examples

plan <- validation_plan(
  structure(
    list(links = list(kappa = "log", thetat = "logit")),
    class = c("bmmodel", "circular", "mixture2p")
  ),
  seed = 1
)
file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
write_plan(plan, file)
identical(read_plan(file)$hash, plan$hash)
#> [1] TRUE
